title: On Kolmogorov's rearrangement problem and Garsia's conjecture
summary: We give negative answers to Kolmogorov's rearrangement problem and Garsia's conjecture. We construct a complete uniformly bounded orthonormal system for which every rearrangement admits a square-summable series divergent almost everywhere. The finite construction uses two copies of the trigonometric system in different orderings. The main ingredient is a combinatorial lemma which guarantees a prescribed ordering along an arithmetic progression in at least one of two related permutations.
